requirements.evidence: All contract routes present with correct names/methods/middleware (routes/web.php:18-44, throttle:6,1 on password.email, signed on verification.verify, auth+verified on home). Login: email:strict, auth.failed on email, lowercase email+IP throttle key with 5 tries and auth.throttle (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:24-43,50-71), session regenerate + redirectIntended(route('home')). Register: key str()->transliterate('register|'.$ip), 5 tries, error on email, Registered event, login + regenerate (Register.php:27-50,57-77). Password::defaults set once (AppServiceProvider.php:30). Reset rotates remember_token and fires PasswordReset (PasswordResetController.php:51-58); single email input in reset view. EmailVerificationRequest guards tampered ids. .env.example, phpunit.xml locale pins and lang/{en,pt_BR}/ui.php added. Small gaps: existing views (welcome, bulma-test) are not touched in the diff, so the 'every view under resources/views' requirement relies on them already being clean; the hardcoded-path test does not check controllers/Livewire classes for redirect('/...') despite its name.

conventions.evidence: Livewire components validate with inline $this->validate([...]) arrays (Login.php:25-28, Register.php:33-37) instead of the project's #[Validate] attributes / rules() required by conventions and policy rule 1. No CHANGELOG.md/README/docs updates although conventions require docs kept in sync. User creation (a write) is done inline via User::create in the component rather than an app/Actions class. Otherwise good: route() everywhere, plain wire:model, controllers use inline $request->validate for small rule sets, Bulma markup with labels, $fillable kept via #[Fillable], {{ }} escaping.

security.evidence: Rate limiting inside Livewire actions (Login.php:30,51-66; Register.php:59-73), session regeneration on login/register, invalidate + regenerateToken on logout (LogoutController.php:13-16), non-enumerating forgot-password response (PasswordResetController.php:25-29), remember_token rotation, EmailVerificationRequest 403 on tampered id, signed+throttled verify, throttled resend, all output escaped with {{ }}. Minor: layout falls back to loading Bulma from a CDN without SRI (components/layouts/app.blade.php:12); the plaintext password stays in the public Livewire property after a failed attempt (contract-mandated, but it is not reset).

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Auth/AuthFlowTest.php covers locale (pt_BR and en), login success/failure/rate-limit with pt_BR message, guest redirect, register happy path/validation/unique/confirmed/rate limit, logout, home auth+verified, forgot password non-disclosure and 429 on 7th request, single email input, remember_token rotation + PasswordReset event, bad token/weak password, verification, tampered link 403 (verifies nobody), unsigned link 403, resend for verified/unverified. Missing: Livewire-policy unauthorized-call test (e.g. authenticated user calling Login::submit / Register::submit via update requests), and the 'never hardcode paths' test only checks views, not redirect('/...') in classes.

simplicity.evidence: Lean controllers using framework primitives (PasswordBroker, EmailVerificationRequest, redirectGuestsTo/redirectUsersTo). Some duplication of the throttle/auth.throttle message block between Login.php:49-66 and Register.php:57-74; two layouts (layouts/app.blade.php delegating to components/layouts/app.blade.php) is a small but justified indirection; the CDN fallback branch in the layout is unnecessary code.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods, clear names (ensureIsNotRateLimited, throttleKey), helpful comments (PasswordResetController.php:25-26, EmailVerificationController.php:24-25), consistent Blade form markup. Test file is dense in places (multiple chained assertions on one line, e.g. AuthFlowTest.php:24-27) and submit() methods lack return types.

scope.evidence: Nearly everything serves the task. Minor extras: CDN Bulma fallback and always-open navbar in components/layouts/app.blade.php:9-13,22; welcome text in home. No out-of-scope mail theme, Docker, SCSS/JS or docs changes.

issues.explanation: Livewire public properties are validated with inline rule arrays instead of #[Validate] attributes (or rules()), which the conventions and the mandatory Livewire security policy (rule 1) require.
Conventions require docs and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] to be updated in the same change; a new auth flow is added without any documentation update.

No unauthorized-call/tamper test for the Livewire actions (e.g. an authenticated user invoking Login::submit or Register::submit through an update request) as the Livewire definition of done requires.
The 'views and auth classes never hardcode paths' test only scans Blade views; it never checks controllers or Livewire classes for redirect('/...').
The user-creation write happens directly in the component instead of an app/Actions use-case class as the conventions prescribe for writes.
Adds an unrequested fallback that loads Bulma 0.9.4 from a third-party CDN without integrity attributes when no Vite build exists.
The lockout message construction is duplicated across the two components.
The task's hardcoded-link rule covers existing views, but they are not touched; correctness depends on them already using route(), which cannot be confirmed from the diff.

review.summary: The change implements the full session auth flow (Livewire login/register, logout, password reset, e-mail verification, pt_BR-first localization) with correct route contract, rate limiting, remember_token rotation, non-enumerating responses and a broad feature test suite. It is functionally strong, but the Livewire components skip the mandated #[Validate] pattern (a policy item that blocks review), docs/CHANGELOG are not updated and Livewire unauthorized-call tests are missing, so it needs changes before merging.
